newsitem.title: PERU: Peru Q1 trade gap off 24.8 pct vs yr-ago - customs.
newsitem.headline: Peru Q1 trade gap off 24.8 pct vs yr-ago - customs.

text.p: Peru's first quarter trade deficit fell 24.8 percent to $298.70 million compared with $397.18 million in the same period last year, according to Customs Service figures released Wednesday.
Customs said exports rose 11.09 percent to $1.571 billion, while imports were up 3.22 percent to $1.870 billion.
The Customs figures do not include all the data used to calculate the Central Reserve Bank's official trade balance figures, which are published later.
